activity.title: Following water as it changes state
activity.learning_objective: Explain liquid water changing to water vapor.
activity.explanation: Evaporation changes liquid water into water vapor, a gas. A puddle can shrink as water evaporates into the air. The water has changed state; it has not disappeared.
activity.exercise_text: Read the passage about evaporation, then explain how liquid water becomes water vapor.

practice_questions.prompt_text: Describe the water's starting and ending states during evaporation.

fresh_check.prompt_text: A learner says evaporation makes water disappear. Explain how liquid water and water vapor describe the same water in different states.
